description: Convert torque between newton-meters, foot-pounds, inch-pounds, kilogram-meters and more. Enter a value once and see it in every unit instantly.

faqs.q: What is the SI unit of torque?
faqs.a: The newton-meter (N·m): one newton of force applied at one meter from the pivot.

faqs.q: How many foot-pounds are in a newton-meter?
Is torque the same as energy?
faqs.a: They share units (N·m = joule) but are different quantities: torque is a rotational force, energy is work done. They must never be interchanged.
